Introducing Saved Views, available today on all paid plans. Every project has its own rhythm, and the way you filter, sort, and group your tasks shouldn't have to be rebuilt every time you open a list. With Saved Views, you can capture any configuration exactly as you set it up and return to it instantly, whether that's a filtered backlog, a sprint board sorted by priority, or a custom timeline for stakeholders.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize views around projects, clients, or workflows. Need your team on the same page? Views can be shared, so anyone on the team can open the same filtered perspective without recreating your setup from scratch. This keeps standups, reviews, and reporting consistent across the board.

Saved Views is rolling out now to all paid plan customers at no extra cost. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
